introHtml: Cotton pet toys offer a natural, soft, and durable option for dogs who love to chew and play. Unlike synthetic materials, cotton is gentle on teeth and gums, making it ideal for aggressive chewers or teething puppies. Bulk buyers often choose cotton rope toys or plush pull toys for pet store giveaways, shelter fundraising events, or employee pet-friendly perks. Screen printing or embroidered logos hold well on cotton webbing and fabric, giving your brand a cozy, approachable feel that resonates with pet owners.
